newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds tradeless in frozen market.
newsitem.headline: European feeds tradeless in frozen market.

text.p: European meals and feeds remained untraded by the end of the morning on Friday as many participants remained absent and ice-blocked canals pre-occupied those left in the market.
Traders said they expected physical business to remain in the doldrums probably until the middle of next week but much depended on how the weather situation developed.

Many waterways and tributaries were frozen sold although the Rhine was still negotiable, they said. But the situation was bad enough to keep many consumers busy organizing alternative transport for deliveries. -- Amsterdam Newsroom +31 20 504 5000
